name: file_carver
description: Carve files from a raw binary dump by header/footer signatures. Given a path, an offset, and a signature type, extracts the file (using header size fields or footer markers), computes SHA256, and returns JSON with offset, size, hash, and first 128 bytes hex.

path.description: Path to the raw binary dump to carve from

offset.description: Byte offset where the file signature starts

sig_type.description: Signature type with a lossless size parser: PE, ZIP, PDF, SQLite, regf, PNG, JPEG, GIF

max_size.description: Safety ceiling for a complete file (default 100MB); a larger file is refused, never cut

output.description: Optional output file path. If omitted, returns metadata only.
